description: Run a prompt or conversation through a language model on the user's Corent account. Synchronous: returns the text, usage and exact charge. Corent picks the model; set quality "best" only when the user asks for the best answer, max_cost_cents for a budget, model to pin one. For work billed to Corent, not your own reasoning. Supports tool calling and JSON mode.

max_cost_cents.description: The most this answer may cost, in cents, counted on max_tokens. Set it when the user gives a budget. Refused before anything is spent when no model fits under it, and never exceeded.

max_tokens.description: Cap on the reply length in tokens (default 1024). The balance gate reserves against this, so keep it realistic.

messages.description: Full OpenAI-shaped conversation, for multi-turn work: prior assistant turns, and the tool results you are feeding back after a tool call. Takes precedence over prompt/system. Without this the model sees only one question and has no memory of the exchange.

model.description: Pin an exact text model by name, e.g. "corent-claude-opus-5" (list_models shows the menu with kind="text"; every name there is spelled corent-*). Never substituted, flat cost-plus price. Use it when the user wants a particular model's answer: a model named inside a chat prompt is NOT picked up, so pass it here.

prompt.description: What to ask, in plain language. Use this for a single question; use `messages` instead to continue a conversation.

quality.description: Set "best" only when the user asks for the best or highest quality: Corent then uses its top model for the job, which costs more. Leave it out otherwise and Corent picks the model. Has no effect when `model` pins one.

response_format.description: Structured output, e.g. {"type":"json_object"} for JSON mode, or a json_schema block.

system.description: Optional system instruction that frames the request

temperature.description: Sampling temperature; omit for the model's default

tool_choice.description: How the model may use tools: "auto", "none", "required", or {type:"function",function:{name}}.

tools.description: OpenAI-shaped function definitions the model may call. When the model answers with tool calls, they come back in `tool_calls` and the reply text is empty: run them, then call again with `messages` carrying the assistant turn and your tool results.

name: generate_text
title: Generate text (language model)
